HISTORY SWEEP / CHANGELOG

A record of
what’s changed.

See additions and improvements by version, with published releases, candidates and work in development marked separately.

Release notes

Each record describes a package. Check your installed version before comparing features.

v0.6.0Published

Cleanup on your schedule, a workspace of your own

  • Create local cleanup tasks with one-time, daily, weekly or monthly schedules and optional inactivity conditions. Preview before enabling; kept websites take priority. Browser shutdown or sleep can delay execution.
  • Manage cleanup tasks and WebDAV backups in the same settings window. Reorder or hide browsing views, and review unsaved preferences before closing.
  • Copy a full URL without changing selection. Expand local activity in place, and hide cleanup activity with Soft privacy while keeping its records.
  • Receive a local nameplate with a one-time first-install reveal. Replay it from the card icon; reduced motion skips the entrance animation.
  • Open Quick start and offline release notes from Preferences. Version & updates separates published versions from Chrome-ready downloads and protects active work before reloading.
v0.5.0Published

More ways to browse and keep your preferences

  • Browse by visit frequency within a chosen period. Choose your default view and date range.
  • Private cleanup skips saving new cleanup activity. Return to the top of long results with one click.
  • Manually transfer lightweight preferences with WebDAV, or save an encrypted disk backup. Browsing history is excluded.
v0.4.0Published

A clearer history workspace

  • Review browsing and verified cleanup activity by year or three months, with daily website summaries stored locally.
  • Switch between date and website groups without losing your selection. Browse the last three local calendar days by default.
  • Delete a single row while keeping a batch selection. Clearer deletion feedback and automatic refresh when idle.
  • Choose automatic, light or dark appearance across extension views.
v0.3.2Archived package

Date filters and website shortcuts

Reconstructed from the archived package. Exact publication dates are not recorded here.

  • Filter by local dates and review selected URLs grouped by website before deletion.
  • Keep chosen domains and their subdomains out of cleanup. Start an exact-host search from the current website or its right-click menu.
  • Choose popup, in-page modal or full-page opening. Store installs can show an update-ready banner.
v0.3.1Published

Website groups and local suggestions

  • Search suggestions come from local history. Group results by website and select whole groups.
  • Normalize title and URL text for matching, and show feedback after verified deletion.
v0.3.0Archived package

Search, review and clear selected history

Reconstructed from the archived package. Exact publication dates are not recorded here.

  • Search Chrome history by domain, title or URL, then select and confirm the URLs to delete.
  • Use the popup or full workspace in English or Simplified Chinese. Confirmed deletion continues in the background while Chrome stays open.

v0.6.0 includes offline notes in Preferences → Version & updates. The package and website share the same release notes.
